title: 碎岩 · 黄昏的反击
style: Instrumental cinematic action score for a 75-second animated duel in an abandoned construction site at sunset. No singing, no choir, no speech, no sound effects. D minor, 132 BPM. A memorable four-note rising cello motif connects all sections. Opening: 12 seconds of sparse low cello, muted piano and airy strings with space for dialogue. Build: tightly articulated violas, dry low taiko and restrained analog bass pulse. Middle: forceful syncopated percussion, driving string ostinato and short brass answers; one sudden half-beat rest before the strongest return. Final section: percussion drops away, the four-note motif returns on solo cello with an unresolved dark piano note and a clean soft decay. Clear acoustic orchestral detail, controlled low end, wide but focused stereo, strong quiet-to-loud contrast, dramatic phrasing, no constant wall of sound, no long introduction, no EDM drop.
purpose: Replace both previous music tracks with an edited cue from a single Suno composition.
